title: Delivery pipeline loop gates
description: Fail-closed gates wiring the ticket-delivery conveyor into the GSD loop: a blocking plan:post gate runs the ticket-graph validator (Gate 2), so a decomposition without materialized, valid PLAN files cannot pass planning.

delivery_pipeline.graph_gate.description: Run the delivery-pipeline ticket-graph validator as a blocking plan:post gate (mechanical Gate 2).

delivery_pipeline.uat_gate.description: Block ship until the phase has verification evidence (fail-closed `phase uat-passed` predicate at ship:pre).

delivery_pipeline.arch_verdict.description: Advisory ship:pre agent verdict: check the phase's changes against locked ADR decisions in .planning/architecture/ and surface violations before shipping.

delivery_pipeline.sentinel.description: PR sentinel: 'auto' leaves a guard on the open PRs (a background agent where the runtime has one, otherwise a mandatory duty pass each round) so delivery can cascade onward; 'off' keeps every PR in the main loop.

delivery_pipeline.auto_merge.description: Ticket-PR landing: 'epic' lets the sentinel squash a green + arch-conform ticket PR into its base (phase epic or parent ticket branch) once the gate is re-verified against live GitHub; 'off' leaves every merge to a human. The epic -> integration-branch PR is NEVER auto-merged, and human_checkpoint tickets are always excluded.

agentVerdict.prompt: Architecture conformance (advisory). If .planning/architecture/ contains no ADR-*.md, verdict: pass. Otherwise: extract locked decisions and scope fences from every ADR (plus INTERFACES.md/DATA-MODEL.md when present), diff the phase's implemented changes (merge-base..HEAD), and judge conformance only against recorded decisions — style and bugs belong to other reviewers. Report each violation as file:line + the violated ADR section + minimal remediation direction. If the code is right and a decision no longer fits reality, say adr-outdated and name the decision — changing it is the human's call. Never block; this verdict is advisory context for the ship decision.
